decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the plans numbered Bfd-A-(03)11-P1, dated 24/10/12, received 6/11/12, Bfd-A-(02)14-P1, dated 25/10/12, received 6/11/12, Bfd-A-(02)04-P1, dated 25/10/12, received 6/11/12, Bfd-00-A(02)01-P1, dated 01/11/12, received 6/11/12, and Bfd-A-(03)01-P1, dated 24/10/12, received 6/11/12, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external windows and doors hereby permitted will be double glazed powder coated aluminium and shall be of a configuration that matches the existing windows and doors.
description: To carry out various works to the building including re-roofing of the building and replacement of external doors, windows and rooflights
